Live POST {term:'*',limit:1,sort:'RELEVANCE'} returned totalResultsFound=5244. resolveKlevuKey self-heal present. Probe only runs when expectedProductCount absent, but the method string is valid and functional.

The promoted DB profile uses crawlers.watermark.NOTES (no reason key) -> the live DB profile would FAIL the required 'sortVerification' check. Distinct from marstar's api-date issue (line 115-117): here it's a key-name mismatch (reason vs notes) on the full-catalog-sweep path. FIX: DB profile needs a 'reason' field added. (Skill should emit 'reason' for full-catalog-sweep -- R1 candidate did, DB does not.)

Klevu is the PRIMARY surface via GLOBAL wildcard SEARCH (query.term='*', sort RELEVANCE), paged by offset=(page-1)*perPage. It does NOT filter by category. _resolveKlevuCategoryPath was REMOVED (comment 287-294); klevuCategoryPaths + catalogUrls are runtime-inert for COVERAGE (catalogUrls only seed stream slots). One global offset-walk = 100% coverage.
